provenance.what: Rows of the node-graph opening-camera law: graph bounds + viewport + stored camera -> the camera a surface opens on.
provenance.law: A stored camera is adopted only when it already shows at least `minCoverage` of the graph's own area; otherwise the graph is fitted with `paddingPx` of screen margin per side and the zoom clamped to the canvas camera range. `refits` is the separate, far stricter gate an ALREADY LIVE camera passes when the graph changed under it (an example switch).
provenance.calibration: `minCoverage` 0.85 is the one judgement call here. The live generation3d boot camera (x=94.75 y=-97.5 zoom=1.78 in a 483x814 pane) covers 0.570 of its own graph and shows one node of seven, so 0.6 would have decided it by 0.03; 0.85 decides it by 0.28 and still adopts a camera with a sliver of the graph off the edge.

rows.name: a-surface-with-no-stored-camera-fits-its-whole-graph
rows.why: The first attach of a graph nobody has framed yet must show all of it, not the world origin.

rows.name: a-stored-camera-that-already-frames-the-graph-is-adopted
rows.why: A camera the viewer set and that still shows the graph is never overridden.

rows.name: a-stored-camera-with-a-small-overhang-is-still-adopted
rows.why: The framing test is a coverage threshold, not exact containment; a sliver off the edge is tolerated.

rows.name: a-stored-camera-that-only-shows-three-quarters-is-replaced-by-the-fit
rows.why: Three quarters is not 'framed'. The live generation3d boot camera measures 0.570 of its graph.

rows.name: a-stored-camera-showing-half-the-graph-is-replaced-by-the-fit
rows.why: The boot defect this law closes: the stored camera shows one node of seven and still wins.

rows.name: a-stored-camera-that-left-the-graph-entirely-is-replaced-and-would-refit
rows.why: An example switch can move the whole graph out of view; zero coverage refits even a live camera.

rows.name: a-graph-larger-than-the-zoom-floor-is-centred-not-over-zoomed
rows.why: fit_camera clamps to the canvas camera range instead of returning an unusable zoom.

rows.name: a-single-node-graph-fits-to-its-own-box
rows.why: One node is still content; the fit frames it rather than falling back to zoom 1.

rows.name: a-zero-height-graph-is-measured-on-the-axis-it-has
rows.why: A row of nodes at one y must not read as zero coverage and refit forever.

rows.name: an-empty-graph-leaves-the-stored-camera-alone
rows.why: Nothing to frame is not a reason to move the viewer's camera.
